  "phoneNote": "The page is readable and orderly, but the photo-first hero delays the service headline and leaves location and direct contact information far down the page.",

    "Put the mobile headline before a shallower hero image, and bring the Maribor/online detail into the hero on both screens with a clear first-meeting contact action.",
    "Rebalance desktop scale: shorten the tall image sections, reduce the footer wordmark substantially, and give the three price options equal-width columns with smaller headings and clear gutters.",
    "Develop a tutoring-specific visual identity through restrained graph-paper details, mathematical notation and numbered process steps rather than relying on generic blue buttons and study-desk imagery."
